headline: Week 17: Derrick Henry Punts a Toddler Through a Wall, Mustard Squirts Everywhere, and Stroud Boys Score 78
subhead: Championship-window football and somehow Stroud Boys still showed up looking like a Tuesday morning bye-week lineup.
matchOfTheWeek: Christian McCalfinjury 175.16, McBridesStrangeWhiteHock 172.60 — a 2.56-point heart attack decided by Derrick Henry hanging FORTY-FIVE on Baltimore's behalf while Trey McBride (28.6) and Malik Willis (31.5, lol) tried to drag Rocks across the line. The kicker: Wunder ALSO left Jacory Croskey-Merritt and his 22.5 on the bench and still won, which is the most McCalfinjury thing imaginable. Rocks loses by a field goal in a game where his QB was Malik Willis — somewhere a therapist is getting a phone call.
mainRecap:
Let's start with the carnage. Christian McCalfinjury rode King Henry's 45.60 and CMC's 28.10 to a championship-grade 175 and left 22.5 bench points on the table while doing it — that's not a lineup, that's a flex. Rocks gave him a real fight on the back of Trey McBride and a Malik Willis 31-burger that nobody on Earth saw coming, and still got cooked by 2.56. Brutal. Frame it.

Nut Olave Your Face dropped 170 on Browning Out behind Mustard's 39.90 and Charbonnet quietly stuffing 26 into the box score. Patrick hit 96.2% lineup efficiency — the best mark in the league — and still got run off the field by 24, which is the fantasy equivalent of acing the test and getting expelled for the outfit. Nail polish enthusiast was not needed today; Bijan handled it personally.

Egbukkake stomped Little Peckers 159–127, with QB1.02 going for 32.44 and Chase Brown adding 29. Szara also benched Tyler Shough's 21.92 because of course he did — even in a 32-point win he finds a way to remind you Erick All is still on the roster somewhere. Papi got 27.20 from Rhamondre and still ate it; Unc Aaron Jones could not save him.

Then there's the QAmon vs. Stroud Boys game, a 93–78 grease fire that should be classified as a war crime under the Geneva Convention. Stroud Boys put up SEVENTY-EIGHT POINTS in Week 17. Money Mill$ is not money. The Prodigal Son did not return. QAmon won and somehow looked worse doing it — congrats Kyle, you beat the lowest score of the week by 15 with a 93-spot of your own. Tiny-Handed Vampire would be ashamed.

And a moment of silence for T swift's Baddies, who scored 95 while leaving 50.44 on the bench — Luther Burden's 27.80 sat there like a centerpiece at a dinner nobody attended. Optimal lineup: 145.94. Actual: 95.50. That's not a lineup mistake, that's a hostage situation.

powerRankings.blurb: 175 points, a 2-point W, and 22 bench points to spare — Wunder is operating on cheat codes and Derrick Henry's bloodstream.
Mustard squirted 39.90, Charbonnet chipped in 26, and Browning Out got hosed by 24 — the throne is heavy and Nick is comfortable.
QB1.02 and Chase Brown went brrr for a 32-point beatdown, and Szara STILL found 21.92 to leave on the bench because tradition matters.
Lost by a field goal with Malik Willis as your QB — that's heartbreaking AND embarrassing, a real Rocks special.
League-best 96.2% lineup efficiency and a 24-point loss — peak 'did everything right and got nothing for it' energy.
Brock Purdy went for 37.92 in a week Cubby wasn't even playing for anything — the universe's cruelest scheduling joke.
Jake Tonges hung 22.5 on the bench — when a guy named Tonges is your what-if, the season has spoken.
Stefon Diggs put up 22.1 from the pine — Mig is collecting bench points like Pokémon cards at this point.
A 93.78-point 'win' is not a win, it's a participation trophy with ShAmon-Ra's name carved sideways.
Left 50.44 points on the bench including a 27.80 from Luther Burden — that's not lineup management, that's sabotage.
Rhamondre dropped 27.2 and Papi still ate a 32-point loss — Unc cannot carry this team alone, the man is tired.
78.78 points in Week 17 — Money Mill$ is bankrupt, the Prodigal Son got lost on the way home, and bjewett is in shambles.
